production.note: US model years. First: Mazda's brochure for the '2010 mazdaspeed 3', 'Based on the all new, all that 2010 MAZDA3 5-Door' (the 2007-2009 car is the first generation). Last: Mazda's 2013 Mazda3 brochure still lists the MAZDASPEED3 at 263 hp (mazda-us-2013-mazda3-brochure); the following Mazda3 generation had no Mazdaspeed version, but no opened Mazda page says in so many words that 2013 was the last model year.

body.note: 'Based on the all new, all that 2010 MAZDA3 5-Door'; sold only as a 5-door hatchback

displacementL.note: '2.3-liter MZR'. No opened page gives the cc figure; Carey Russ's spec panel gives '2.3 liters / 138 cu. in.' (theautochannel-russ-2010-mazdaspeed3).

aspiration.note: 'MZR 2.3-liter all-aluminum 4-cylinder turbocharged, intercooled & direct-injected engine'; Mazda's 2009 New York show material calls it the 'MZR 2.3L DISI Turbo' (autoguide-2010-mazdaspeed3-debut)

drivetrain.note: 'Drivetrain: Transverse front engine, front-wheel drive'. Mazda's brochure lists a 'Torque-sensing conical limited-slip differential'.

transmission.note: 'Close-ratio 6-speed manual gearbox'; no automatic was offered

powerHp.note: 2010 model year. Quote: "263 hp @ 5500 rpm/280 lb-ft of torque @ 3000 rpm". Mazda's 2009 New York show material: "MZR 2.3L DISI Turbo producing 263 horsepower at 5,500 rpm" (autoguide-2010-mazdaspeed3-debut). Unchanged through 2013: "263 hp @ 5,500 rpm" (mazda-us-2013-mazda3-brochure).

weightLb.note: 2010 Mazdaspeed3 Sport (the base trim), 6-speed manual. No Mazda curb weight was found: the 2010, 2011, 2012 and 2013 Mazda brochures opened give none for the Mazdaspeed3, and Car and Driver is blocked. Same figure from two editorial reviews with named authors: Carey Russ, quote: "Curb Weight: 3245 lbs."; John Heilig (The Auto Page), quote: "Curb weight: 3,245 lbs." (theautochannel-heilig-2010-mazdaspeed3). Both reviews are hosted on The Auto Channel.
